subject.title: amazon-bedrock provider: Haiku 4.5 inference profile ARN not supported; params.modelId override ignored

question: Which Bedrock request identity contract should OpenClaw support for Haiku 4.5 inference profiles: discovered/profile model IDs, a documented `params.modelId` override, or explicit full ARN model refs?
rationale: Current code already has inference-profile discovery but does not define `params.modelId` as request identity, and the choice affects documented config, provider routing, and upgrade expectations.

options.title: Use profile model IDs
options.body: Make selected Bedrock catalog/profile model IDs the canonical request identity and add alias/config support only where discovery cannot expose the required profile.

options.title: Document `params.modelId` override
options.body: Treat per-model `params.modelId` as a Bedrock-only request identity override and add schema/docs/tests proving precedence and fallback behavior.

options.title: Require explicit ARN refs
options.body: Support full Bedrock inference-profile ARN refs as selected model IDs and reject hidden identity overrides.

recommendation.title: Use profile model IDs
recommendation.body: Make selected Bedrock catalog/profile model IDs the canonical request identity and add alias/config support only where discovery cannot expose the required profile.

likelyOwner.reason: wirjo authored the closest merged inference-profile behavior and is the clearest owner signal for the Bedrock identity contract.
